notes.title: v1.0.1 Stability Patch
notes.notes:
Fixes


 Fixed a bug when interacting with the inventory.
 Resolved issues in the first level where objects were not appearing correctly.

notes.title: Next Update Information #2
notes.notes:
Dimenders next major update is currently in closed beta testing.

With this update, the game will officially leave Early Access.

I don't have a precise release date yet, but if all goes well, it should be ready in November.

notes.title: Next Update Information
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on a major update that includes features such as:

- New items
- New monsters
- New levels
- New ending
- Rework of all existing levels
- Improve storyline
- Improve voice chat

And much more! Expected to be released in the coming months.
